explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 714 days after the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the azacitidine shortage on 2020-12-18 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
Our Corvale General and Corvale East inventory both carry NDC 16729030610 labeled by Accord Healthcare Inc.
That NDC's SPL set ID 70140e11 names Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1191818 at that plant ended 2022-12-02 and was classified OAI with 11 observations on sterile procedures and laboratory controls.
The OAI classification letter is dated 2023-04-05, which is 838 days after the shortage posting.
An import alert 66-40 for Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited was published 2023-06-01 and a warning letter issued 2023-07-28 for the same FEI.
The rule-based best option is to transfer 15 units of 100 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give each site 14 days on hand.
